# activity-arm

<!-- AUTOGENERATED:BEGIN — do not edit; regenerated by `./singularity build` -->

## Plugin reference

- Description: The page arm's presence in every list of activity: its rows open the page in Pages. Its band's fields are its entity's exposures, presented by their own plugins. The page arm of the activity space: binds the live page rows of `page_blocks` into the activity union (title from the page's data, last change of its row); every field exposed on a page folds into its band.
- Web:
  - Contributes:
    - `FieldPresentation.Register` "arm:activity:page"
    - `DataViewSlots.CollectionRowActivation` "activity:open"
  - Uses:
    - `activity.activityLinks`
    - `network/live.FieldPresentation`
- Server:
  - Uses:
    - `activity.activityServed`
    - `page/editor._blocks`
  - Register: `serveArm('activity:page')`
- Core:
  - Uses:
    - `activity.activity`
    - `network/live.liveArm`
    - `page/block-entity.pagesEntityRef`
  - Exports (values): `pageActivityArm`
